title: RealCLI：面向CLI智能体的人机协作统一评测基准
summary: RealCLI是一个配对基准，统一评估CLI智能体的任务执行与人机协作质量。它构建五维协作框架（22个子维度、51个交互场景模板），提供执行模式与协作模式对比。结果显示前沿智能体最高平均分仅49.2%，联合协作分仅37.6%，在可引导性、信任校准和安全边界管理上明显不足。
summary_en: REALCLI is a paired benchmark unifying evaluation of task execution and human-agent collaboration quality on realistic CLI tasks. It builds a five-dimensional collaboration framework (22 sub-dimensions, 51 interaction scenario templates) with EXEC and COLLAB modes. Frontier agents score only 49.2% on average and 37.6% on joint collaboration, struggling with steerability, trust calibration, and safety boundaries.
